core: This vault stores paraphrased, teachable coaching knowledge for education and content generation. Focus on actionable techniques that develop leadership and coaching competencies.

paraphrase_rules: Never copy source text verbatim (max 30 words per quote)
Write actionable definitions with observable behaviors
Include boundary conditions and failure modes
banned_patterns: generic leadership theory without source grounding
external frameworks not mentioned in source (ICF, PMI, etc.)

steps.gate: Skip marketing, TOC, testimonials, about-author, legal. Focus on core chapters with definitions, frameworks, and procedures.
steps.model: Write actionable notes: define the concept, explain operationalization (how to observe/measure), state boundary conditions (when it applies/fails). Include Gap Statements for missing evidence.
steps.verify: Ensure YAML derived_from is present. No placeholder-only sections. No quotes over 30 words.
steps.story: Create engaging coaching scenarios that demonstrate the concepts in realistic workplace situations.

lenses.dbm: Model with DBM frames: TOTE structure, observable indicators, calibration cues. Focus on behavioral patterns.
